authoritative_rule: Agents MUST refresh current main and repository evidence before selecting or claiming a slot. queue_anchor_main_sha is an audit anchor, not permission to work from a stale base. Query bounded native execution, bounded Relations predicate runtime, real-WordPress execution evidence, fail-closed cache/diagnostics rules and the non-runtime admin authoring scaffold are promoted through PR #147/#148, #154/#156, #158, #159 and #160. A hosted Copilot assignment attempt remains unavailable through the connected GitHub route, so no hosted-agent claim is represented as active. The actionable queue therefore uses deterministic remote branch claims. Current main plus linked GitHub issue/PR evidence overrides stale prose until Supervisor reconciliation is promoted. Completed/promoted slots remain auditable in Git history and must not be re-claimed or force-moved.

auto_assignment.selection_rule: Choose the highest-priority OPEN slot allowed for the agent role whose dependencies are satisfied and whose runtime/planning boundary remains valid on current main.
auto_assignment.no_valid_slot_behavior: Make no repository changes and report NO_VALID_WORK_SLOT.
revalidation_before_work: Read AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHECKPOINT.md and docs/ENGINEERING-EXECUTION-GOVERNANCE.md.
Read current main SHA and commits since the queue audit anchor, including PR #158, PR #159 and PR #160.
Inspect relevant open and merged PRs/MRs, issues and existing branches.
Verify the selected slot is not already complete, superseded, blocked or claimed.
Verify canonical ownership, dependency order and allowed write scope.
Treat stale Query runtime-not-started prose as superseded by current main only for explicitly promoted slices; do not infer Gate C completion.
Only then create the deterministic claim branch.
revalidation_before_merge: Absorb latest main using the repository-approved non-destructive strategy.
Review the intended diff and Integration Requirements.
Reject any worker diff that edits another active slot's exclusive write boundary or Supervisor-only shared truth.
Require applicable exact-head CI on the final candidate head.
Never use stale CI or force overwrite as merge evidence.
auto_assignment.claim_branch_rule: For DETERMINISTIC_REMOTE_BRANCH_CREATE slots, use the exact claim_branch declared by the slot. Create that remote branch from exact current main without force. Successful remote ref creation claims the slot. If the branch already exists or ref creation is rejected, treat the slot as already claimed and immediately evaluate the next eligible slot.

SUPERVISOR.description: Exactly one user-designated Supervisor/Integrator coordinates shared writes, merge review, queue reconciliation and supervisor-only slots. This role is explicit because independent AI sessions do not have a reliable cross-session lease/heartbeat mechanism.
must_not: Pre-create branches for future worker slots.
Merge a branch only because an agent says it is done.
Treat arrival order as merge order.
Allow dependency-blocked runtime work to start.
Allow parallel workers to edit config/coordination/agent-work-queue.json, CHECKPOINT.md or other shared project-state truth.

WORKER.description: Workers autonomously inspect current repository truth and claim the next eligible non-overlapping work slot using deterministic remote branch creation.
must_not: Modify shared/global truth unless the slot explicitly grants that write scope.
Create a different branch name when the deterministic claim branch is already occupied.
Start runtime work that the slot marks planning_only or dependency_blocked.
Edit files owned exclusively by another OPEN/claimed slot.
